name: Link
summary: A link, in one of the semantic colours. It is text, so it takes the text form of the colour and reads at 4.5:1 on the page, on an overlay and inside a container.
summaryZh: 一个链接,可以有各种语义色。它是文字,所以取的是颜色的文字形态,在页面上、在浮层里、在容器里都读得到 4.5:1。

variants.name: Primary
variants.note: The brand colour, in the form that is guaranteed to read as text.

variants.name: Underlined
variants.note: The line is always there. It is a variant of its own, because a type and an underline can be combined: a danger link may be underlined too.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The body size. It needs no modifier class.

states.name: Hover
states.note: The underline arrives. It is the affordance a reader looks for, and it does not draw a line through every link on the page.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: The focus ring. The shared layer paints one for the controls it knows, and a link is not among them.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: An <a> has no disabled attribute, so the state is aria-disabled: the link stays in the tab order and is still announced, which is what a reader who cannot follow it needs to know.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the link text.

props.name: underline
props.description: Keeps the underline on the link at all times, not only under the pointer.
props.descriptionZh: 让下划线一直留在链接上,而不只是在指针经过时才有。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes the link inert. It adds aria-disabled, and the wrapper refuses to follow it.
props.descriptionZh: 让链接不可用。它会加上 aria-disabled,封装也不会再跟过去。

events.name: click
events.description: The link was followed. It is not emitted while the link is disabled.
events.descriptionZh: 链接被跟随时触发。链接禁用时不会触发。

a11y.notes: A real <a href>, so it is in the tab order, it is announced as a link and it can be opened in a new tab from the browser's own menu. A disabled link uses aria-disabled rather than a class alone: it keeps its place in the tab order and is still announced, which is what a reader who cannot follow it needs to know. The stylesheet makes it inert to the pointer; a keyboard reader still reaches it, so the page has to refuse the activation — the Vue wrapper does that, and plain HTML has to do it in the link's own handler.
a11y.notesZh: 这是真的 <a href>,所以它在 Tab 顺序里,读屏会播报它是一个链接,浏览器自己的菜单也能在新标签页里打开它。禁用态用 aria-disabled,而不只是加一个类:它留在 Tab 顺序里,也会被播报,这正是跟不了它的读者需要知道的。样式表让它对指针无效,键盘仍然够得到它,所以还得由页面来拒绝这次激活 —— Vue 封装会这么做,纯 HTML 就得在自己的处理函数里做。

examples.title: The types
examples.description: Each type takes the text form of its colour, so the link reads as text on the page, on an overlay and inside a container — the raw colour is a fill colour and is not guaranteed to read as writing.
examples.descriptionZh: 每一种类型取的都是对应颜色的文字形态,所以链接在页面上、在浮层里、在容器里都读得出来 —— 颜色本身是填充色,拿来写字是保证不了的。
examples.markup: Primary Success Warning Danger Info

examples.title: States
examples.description: A disabled link is announced as disabled and cannot be followed. It keeps its place in the tab order, because a reader who cannot follow it still has to know that it is there.
examples.descriptionZh: 禁用的链接会被播报为禁用,而且跟不过去。它留在 Tab 顺序里,因为跟不了它的读者仍然得知道它在那儿。
examples.markup: A link you can follow A link you cannot

examples.title: Underlined
examples.description: The underline is a variant of its own, so it can be combined with a type: a danger link may be underlined too.
examples.descriptionZh: 下划线是它自己的一种变体,所以它可以跟类型组合:危险色的链接同样可以带下划线。
examples.markup: Always underlined Danger, underlined

notes: The link takes the text form of the colour, never the raw one: the raw brand colour is a fill colour, and on the brutal theme it is a bright yellow that clears 4.5:1 as a background and nothing at all as writing. The underline is a variant rather than a rule on the base class, because a page may want a link that is underlined at rest and a link that only underlines under the pointer, and the two are not the same thing.
notesZh: 链接取的是颜色的文字形态,不是原始色:原始的品牌色是填充色,在 brutal 这套 mood 里它是一个亮黄色,当底色能到 4.5:1,当写字什么都保证不了。下划线做成变体而不是基类上的规则,因为页面可能想要一条一直有下划线的链接,也可能只想要指针经过时才出现下划线的链接,这两件事不是一回事。
